_comment: HD-066 (adapted) — frontend-tier access gate, defence-in-depth alongside the Function App's Easy Auth + auth_api.py group check. Restricts it-helpdesk-web to authenticated CLG IT and Digital Transformation members only. This is a NEW file for the it-helpdesk-web repo root (none existed previously).
_notes: Tenant ID 03233b9e-777e-4e0e-9ed1-92b5317c5020 (Cognition Education Ltd) is already filled in above.
AAD_CLIENT_ID (0b3f61af-492a-4da6-9790-720d2f39443c) and AAD_CLIENT_SECRET are already set as Static Web App Environment Variables — confirmed live in the Portal.

'allowedRoles: authenticated' permits ANY signed-in CLG user past the frontend gate. The real group restriction (CLG - IT and Digital Transformation, Object ID 49cab434-8d81-44fd-b871-ecead72becdc) happens server-side in auth_api.py on every API call — this frontend gate is a UX improvement (prompts sign-in immediately) and a defence-in-depth layer, not the authoritative control.

If a future SWA custom-roles function is added, 'authenticated' above can be tightened to a specific role name once Static Web Apps' custom role-assignment function (rolesSource) is wired to check the same group Object ID.
